data.title: 约会试衣镜前的第三套选择
data.location: 暖灯柔和的秋装精品店试衣镜前

data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, caramel cropped suede lapel jacket, cream pleated midi skirt, brown leather ankle boots, holding wooden clothes hanger with alternate coat, standing in boutique dressing area, glancing sideways at viewer awaiting approval, subtle blush, poised slight smile, three-panel dressing mirror, warm boutique track lighting, wooden clothing racks blurred behind, full body
data.animaCaption: Modeling a caramel cropped suede jacket over a cream pleated skirt in the boutique dressing area, she holds another coat on a wooden hanger and shoots you a composed sidelong glance for your verdict. Warm shop track lighting highlights her smooth dark hair and the rich suede texture.
data.promptProse: Framed in a clean vertical full-body view inside a sunlit autumn fashion boutique, Shiki Natsume tries on a tailored caramel suede cropped jacket paired with a flowing cream pleated midi skirt and brown leather ankle boots. Holding a second outfit draped over a wooden hanger in one hand, she turns slightly toward the viewer with a faint flush and an expectant look disguised as indifference, warmly lit by overhead gallery-style store spotlights beside a tall dressing mirror.
data.story: 换完第三套秋装走出试衣间，夏目拎着另一件衣架在镜子前站定，表面镇定地抬眸看你，眼底却悄悄等着你的评价——「前两套你都说不错，太敷衍了。这次给个认真的答案，焦糖色这件怎么样？」
